test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution mandates that the state should protect every monument or place of artistic or historic interest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 49**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 49** of the Indian Constitution mandates that the **state should protect every monument or place of artistic or historic interest**.
 
• This Article falls under the **Directive Principles of State Policy**, which are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government.
 
• The purpose of these principles is to create social and economic conditions under which the citizens can lead a good life.
 
• It emphasizes the preservation of the rich cultural heritage of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949 **and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written **constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Directive Principles of State Policy** are enshrined in **Part IV** of the Constitution, from **Articles 36 to 51**.
 
• These principles are** not enforceable by any court**, but they are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• They aim to create social and economic conditions under which citizens can lead a good life and promote the welfare of the people.
